sentences.text:
During the pendency of the proceedings, the parties have arrived at a settlement dated 18.09.2021,
pursuant to which the petitioner was to pay a total sum of Rs. 3.10 lakhs to the respondent No.2.

A sum of Rs. 2.30 lakhs has already been paid to the respondent No.2 and the balance sum of Rs.
80,000/- is being paid today vide DD No. 002312 dated 15.04.2023 drawn on HDFC Bank.
The petitioner is present in Court today and has been identified by Mr. Pankaj Tomar, learned counsel.
The respondent No.2 is also present in Court today and has been identified by SI Baljeet Singh, PS Paschim Vihar (East).
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 24/09/2023 at 16:52:57
The parties state that they have arrived at the settlement out of their own free will and without any undue influence, threat, pressure or coercion.
